name: XP boost
description: Multiplies what a won battle gives: the Digimon's experience, the Digivolutions' (forms') experience and the Bits. The sliders go up to 5x; to go up to 10x, switch on Type values and type them in. Works with Party experience: its shares come from the boosted experience.

options.name: Experience (x)
options.description: The Digimon's experience from a battle, after the game splits it among the fighters (an equipped experience bonus item adds its fifth on top).

options.name: Evolution experience (x)
options.description: The experience of each Digivolution (form) that fought, after the game's cap (10 a battle, 50 past a form's threshold level).

options.name: Bits (x)
options.description: The money from a battle (an equipped money bonus item's fifth included). Bits stop at 9,999,999.

options.name: Type values (up to 10x)
options.description: Off: sliders from 1x to 5x (a higher value in the settings counts as 5x). On: type any value from 1x to 10x.
